subject: Reminder from the mods: please use your membership email

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Reminder from the mods: please use your membership email
parts:
Hi folks,

I'm one of the volunteers helping Hadley moderate spam in this group.
We have it set up so that if you're not a member and you send an email
to the list, it gets put into a moderation list. Unfortunately, it
seems that many of you have multiple email addresses and occasionally
post or respond from an address that has not been registered. Such
messages get added to the moderation queue, delaying the post and
causing us work. To avoid this, please check your membership to see
what address you have registered with and try to use that address when
posting or responding to posts.

Cheers,

Mike

--
